methodologyNotes: Roster covers 14 outdoor flat-top gas griddle models spanning entry-level tabletops through premium freestanding units from Blackstone, Weber, Camp Chef, Pit Boss, Royal Gourmet, Nexgrill, LoCo Cookers, and Halo. Sources are official manufacturer product pages (blackstoneproducts.com, weber.com, campchef.com, pitboss-grills.com, royalgourmetusa.com, nexgrill.com, halocooks.com/atbbq.com, lococookers.com) plus major retailers (Walmart, Amazon, Home Depot, BBQGuys, Lowe's, Bass Pro, Sportsman's). prices are the lowest published US MSRP or list/sale price found on a manufacturer or major-retail page at access time; where the manufacturer site was offline (LoCo) or the SKU varies by retailer (Nexgrill 720-1058A), the corroborating retailer listing for the EXACT named SKU was used. cooking_area_sqin is primary griddle surface only; side_shelves is a boolean (true = at least one folding or fixed prep shelf; a swing-away warming rack alone = false); cooktop_material uses the manufacturer's own description; accessedAt 2026-06-19. Adversarial pass corrected the Royal Gourmet price (no support for $269.99; official current price is $319.99), corrected Halo Elite4B fuel from dual_fuel to propane (the natural-gas conversion kit HZ-3001-B ships separately, the unit ships propane), repointed the Nexgrill source to the verified 720-1058A listing (the brand 'with lid' page is a different 38,000 BTU / 532 sqin variant), repointed the Camp Chef FTG600 source from a promo 'no grill grates' SKU to the standard FTG600 listing, and fixed the Blackstone 36 cooking area from 769 to the official 768 sqin.

products.name: Blackstone 36" Original Griddle (1899/2151)
products.priceNote: Walmart rollback street price ~$344 (April 2026); Blackstone.com list $399-$439
products.provenance: Confirmed 4 burners, 60,000 BTU (15,000 each), propane, two folding side shelves, piezo push-button ignition. Cooking area corrected to 768 sqin (Blackstone/Amazon/BBQGuys all state 768; draft's 769 was off by one). 7-gauge rolled carbon steel surface verified. Blackstone.com lists $399-$439; Walmart 2026 rollback street price ~$344 used.

products.name: Blackstone 28" Original Griddle (1883/2147)
products.priceNote: MSRP per blackstoneproducts.com; street price varies $249-$399
products.provenance: Blackstone.com 28in-w-hood page confirmed $399, 2 burners, 34,000 BTU, propane, side shelves. Cooking area 524 sqin confirmed by Walmart 1883 listing and multiple retailer spec cards. All specs verified.

products.name: Blackstone 22" Tabletop Griddle (1666/2203)
products.provenance: Blackstone.com 2203 page confirmed 361 sqin, dual burners, piezo ignition, $179 list ($161.10 sale), propane, no side shelves. 24,000 BTU confirmed by retailer listings for the current 2-burner model (older 1666 was 339 sqin/24,000 BTU). All specs verified.

products.name: Blackstone Culinary 36" Omnivore Griddle with Hood
products.provenance: Lowe's listing confirmed 768 sqin, 4 burners, 38,000 BTU (Omnivore plate retains heat at lower BTU), propane, folding side shelves, electronic push-button ignition. Culinary/Omnivore generation sold through Lowe's. All specs verified.

products.name: Camp Chef Gridiron 36 Flat Top Grill (FTG36)
products.provenance: Camp Chef official page confirmed $599.99. 48,000 BTU (four 12,000 BTU burners), 634 sqin primary surface, electric Flamethrower ignition, two folding side shelves, pre-seasoned cold rolled steel, all confirmed by DKHardware/retailer spec cards. All specs verified.

products.name: Camp Chef Flat Top Grill 600 (FTG600)
products.priceNote: Sportsman's Warehouse street price; Camp Chef/retailer list ~$449-$499
products.provenance: FTG600 (predecessor to Gridiron 36): 4 burners at 12,000 BTU each (48,000 total), 604 sqin pre-seasoned cold rolled steel confirmed by Camp Chef and multiple retailers. Twist-and-turn piezo ignition. Source repointed from a promo 'no grill grates' SKU page to the standard FTG600 listing. Street ~$429.99; list ~$449-$499.

products.name: Weber Slate 30" Rust-Resistant Griddle (1500014)
products.provenance: Weber.com 1500014 confirmed: 3 burners, 36,000 BTU, 540 sqin (30x18), rust-resistant pre-seasoned carbon steel, 2 side tables, propane, $649 current (from $699), electronic ignition. PC Richard corroborated. All specs verified.

products.provenance: Weber.com/Home Depot/Abt confirmed model 1501345: 3 burners, 36,000 BTU, 504 sqin, rust-resistant carbon steel, 2 side tables, propane, $549, electronic ignition. All specs verified.

products.name: Pit Boss 4-Burner Ultimate Lift-Off Griddle (PB4BGD2)

products.name: Pit Boss 5-Burner Ultimate Griddle (PB5BGD2)

Amazon PB5BGD2 corroborated 647 sqin / 50,000 BTU. Same cooking area as 4-burner; 5th burner adds power density not surface. All specs verified.

products.name: Royal Gourmet GB4000F 36" Flat Top Gas Griddle
products.provenance: Royal Gourmet official page confirmed GB4000F: 4 burners, 52,000 BTU (13,000 each), 748 sqin, 7-gauge pre-seasoned steel, dual collapsible side shelves, electronic ignition, propane. SOURCE REPOINTED: draft's nexgrill.com 'with lid' page is a DIFFERENT variant (38,000 BTU / 532 sqin primary) and contradicts the named 720-1058A; source now points to the verified 720-1058A listing. Home Depot list $399.77.

products.priceNote: Home Depot current price; brand-direct site offline for inventory update

Bass Pro confirmed 46,500 BTU, oil-treated steel cooking surface, SmartTemp digital thermostat. products.name: Halo Elite4B 4-Burner Outdoor Griddle (HZ-1001-XNA)
products.priceNote: MSRP per atbbq.com; halocooks.com lists $1,099.99; Walmart ~$897-$1,099
products.provenance: ATBBQ confirmed $1,199.99, 4 burners / 8 zones, 48,000 BTU (12,000 each), 720 sqin (36x20), hot-rolled steel plate. FUEL CORRECTED dual_fuel->propane: the unit ships and is sold as PROPANE (Amazon title 'Propane Gas Grill'); the natural-gas conversion kit (HZ-3001-B) is sold SEPARATELY across all retailers incl. Halo's own site, so labeling it dual_fuel was misleading. side_shelves=false correct (swing-away warming rack only, no fixed prep shelves). halocooks.com lists $1,099.99.
